entities.summary: Antoine-Guillaume Rampon was a French Army officer who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. He fought in many battles under Napoleon in Italy and Egypt. In one celebrated battle, he rallied his troops to defend the key Monte Negino redoubt against the Austrians. He saw limited service during the Napoleonic Wars. His surname can be found among the names inscribed under the Arc de Triomphe.
